summary: Development-profile installation and read-only source comparison.

provides.name: development-profile
provides.summary: Install predefined skill packages, managed shared files, the profile guide, and the marked instruction block; --check compares without refreshing.

artifacts.name: profile-membership-and-dependencies
artifacts.summary: DEVELOPMENT_SKILL_SOURCES, PROFILE_SKILLS_README and SHARED_SCRIPT_FILES define the managed installation set, including the measurement launcher, adjacent runtime helpers, two shipped settings defaults and installation-owned analyzer pins under target .agents/scripts/.

invariants.statement: Replacement is limited to selected packages, explicitly managed shared files and guide, and the marked AGENTS block; unrelated content is preserved.
An active installation is distinct from editable source and is not refreshed during an ongoing agent run.
